This guide covers mounting and wiring the WX-2048 widget.

=== chunk 1 | Installation Guide > Mounting | location - | 30 tokens ===
--- context ---
Installation Guide
Mounting
--- text ---
- Use four M6 bolts torqued to 9 Nm.
- Leave 50 mm clearance for airflow.
